title: Hurricane
hint: Circle either way and lift. Bigger loops reach farther. Sweep up the field of debris.

title: Whirlpool
hint: Draw tight circles over the floating markers. Match the arrow to pull them into the whirlpool.

title: Swordplay
hint: Swipe through the arrow target. Match its direction for a bonus. Hold and release when the guard ring turns green.

title: Spin Ball
hint: Flick from the ball toward a pocket. Add a curved finish for side spin.

title: Spellcasting
hint: Trace a figure-eight to open a portal. A steady circle conjures a ward.

title: DJ Deck
hint: Scrub the platter back and forth. Keep your drag and releases in rhythm with the beat ring.

title: Forge Bellows
hint: Scrub left and right to stoke the forge. Heat falls between strokes. Release above the green line.

title: Globe Explorer
hint: Drag in any direction to rotate the globe. Bring amber landmarks into the center window.

title: Combination Dial
hint: Turn the fictional puzzle dial in the arrow’s direction. Reach each marked turn and lift.

title: Pottery Wheel
hint: Tap one of the three clay bands to select it. Turn around the wheel to shape that band to its dashed outline.

title: Propeller Lift
hint: Circle to keep the propeller turning. Rise to the marked band and stay there through the next checkpoint.

title: Fishing Reel
hint: Use controlled clockwise turns. Reel toward the center while keeping tension inside the green band.
